verdict.rationale: Fathom lists a 'Conversational meeting assistant' and ships an official MCP server and Claude connector, so users can work with their meeting data through natural language in ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants. The docs frame this mainly as accessing or querying meeting data, not as operating the product broadly through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: documentation of which actions natural-language commands can perform beyond reading meeting data (e.g., configuring settings, managing recordings), details of the in-product conversational assistant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
Connect Fathom to any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL below, then authenticate to access your meeting data.
Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude
